description.value: This spellbook was made from rich dark chocolate and is filled with powerful knowledge.
This spellbook was made from pure white chocolate and is brimming with magical finesse.
This necklace provides a sugary barrier against attacks.
This ring provides a delicious defense for a limited number of uses.
This tasty-looking shield protects from damage and boosts your regeneration.
This quiver may run out of arrows, but it will never run out of treats.
